policyConflicts.decision: Ask guests to confirm arrival/departure timings with hotel; do not publish one as universally guaranteed.

policyConflicts.evidence: Most sources say no pets; Tripadvisor amenities says pets allowed.
policyConflicts.decision: Do not advertise pet friendly. Ask guests to confirm before travel.

policyConflicts.evidence: MMT/Goibibo list smoking rooms but property rules prohibit smoking; Tripadvisor has smoking and non-smoking rooms; Hotels.com designated smoking areas.
Google/Tripadvisor call it free, but MMT/Goibibo sell separate room-only and breakfast plans and Trip.com says contact property for price.
policyConflicts.decision: Say breakfast available, confirm inclusion with chosen rate. Do not promise free breakfast on every stay.

policyConflicts.evidence: Google says parking extra charge; Agoda lists car park; Expedia/Hotels.com say no on-site parking; Hotels.com also mentions nearby paid parking.
policyConflicts.decision: Ask hotel for arrival/parking guidance. Never promise on-site or free parking.
